newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Luxembourg airport to continue growth - study.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg airport to continue growth - study.

text.p: The Grand Duchy expects Luxembourg City airport to continuing growing, forecasting freight volume to reach 500,0000 tonnes before the year 2000 and passengers handled to reach 1.5 million by 2002 at the latest.
Freight volume stood at 286,000 tonnes in 1995, having doubled in the previous six years, a study by Statec, the Luxembourg government statistics office, showed.
In 1995 1.2 million passengers used the airport. Two-thirds were Luxair and Icelandair customers.

In view of the expected growth and to meet future demand, Luxembourg's parliament in June approved a plan for an extension of the airport, which contributed 1.2 percent, or 6.7 billion Luxembourg francs, to gross domestic product in 1995.
